en: The postcard features a monochrome (sepia-toned) photograph of a harbor with sailing ships and waterfront buildings set against a hilly backdrop. The bottom of the image includes printed text in red: 'Sundsvall' on the left and 'Hamnen' on the right, indicating the location and the area's function as a harbor. There is handwritten text across the bottom. The reverse side of the postcard displays a green Swedish postage stamp, address lines, ornate borders, and the printed word 'BREFKORT.' The writing is in Swedish script.
